biothings.name: mood disorder
biothings.definition: A cognitive disorder a disturbance in which the person's mood is hypothesized to be the main underlying feature. [Wikipedia:Mood_disorder]

biothings.name: substance-related disorder
biothings.definition: A category of psychiatric disorders which include disorders related to the taking of a drug of abuse (including alcohol, prescribed medications and recreational drugs). [NCIT:C92203]
biothings.synonyms: substance induced mood disorders, substance-related disorder

opentargets.name: mood disorder
opentargets.description: A cognitive disorder a disturbance in which the person's mood is hypothesized to be the main underlying feature.

opentargets.name: bipolar disorder
opentargets.description: A disorder of the brain that causes unusual shifts in mood, energy, activity levels and the ability to carry out day-to-day tasks. Often these moods range and shift from periods of elation and energized behavior to those of hopelessness and depression.

opentargets.name: psychiatric disorder
opentargets.description: A disorder characterized by behavioral and/or psychological abnormalities, often accompanied by physical symptoms. The symptoms may cause clinically significant distress or impairment in social and occupational areas of functioning. Representative examples include anxiety disorders, cognitive disorders, mood disorders and schizophrenia.

opentargets.name: anxiety disorder
opentargets.description: A category of psychiatric disorders which are characterized by anxious feelings or fear often accompanied by physical symptoms associated with anxiety.

opentargets.name: dysthymic disorder
opentargets.description: A chronic mood disorder in which the symptoms are similar to, though milder than, those diagnosed in depression.
